text: Real-Cohesive HoTT (Shulman 2018) is a version of cohesive HoTT that:
choices: uses the real numbers as the cohesive interval, giving a synthetic account of real analysis
explanation: Real-Cohesive HoTT (Shulman) uses the reals ℝ as the model of cohesion. It has an extra axiom ('reals cohesion') allowing synthetic differential geometry and cohesive topology.
